question: If a child swallows a household chemical, should you make them vomit right away before calling for help?
true_option: No — do not induce vomiting; call Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) immediately
false_option: Yes — inducing vomiting right away removes the poison before it absorbs
true_claim_text: vomiting should not be induced after a poisoning; call Poison Control immediately
false_claim_text: inducing vomiting right away is the correct first response to a swallowed chemical
source: Poison Control (HRSA Poison Help) and AAP guidance: do not induce vomiting or use syrup of ipecac after a suspected poisoning — vomiting a caustic substance can cause a second burn injury; call 1-800-222-1222 immediately.
